query: /llm-wiki on a topic with notes across several directories
expected_behavior: Searches the whole repository for related notes
Builds an index page and linked sub-pages under _wiki/ named by the topic slug
Every sub-page claim traces back to a source note
Re-scans the repository and updates pages with anything new
Prunes content no longer backed by source notes

query: /llm-wiki on a topic with no related notes
expected_behavior: Reports that nothing was found instead of inventing content
